title: Kanban Board · ncurses Terminal
summary: A classic ncurses/TUI Kanban board on a tinted near-black canvas with full monospace, reverse-video header and column title bars, bordered dialog-window columns, bracketed field and state notation, restrained ANSI-like semantic colors, a status line consistent with the visible sync error, and an inactive key-map reference labelled display-only (no active shortcuts) — no glow, gradients, graph paper, or backdrop blur.
